verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right: it keeps a strip of the pop-art shapes (pink circle, navy quarter, yellow stripe) and puts the headline and CTA in sensible order. But the FIZZBANG pill straddles the line where the art meets the white panel and sits jammed against the shapes, and there is uneven dead white space between the headline and the CTA. B throws away nearly all the pop-art graphics (only a blue sliver is left at the edge) and crams everything together: the logo pill touches the canvas edge and nearly collides with the oversized headline, which runs almost into the CTA, so there is no breathing room and the brand's feel is lost.
